Scope and packages

Fixed scope. Written before we start.

Hourly billing rewards the builder for taking longer. With a fixed scope, the deliverables, the price and the delivery date are written into the proposal and signed before work begins. If something takes us longer than planned, that is our cost. If you want something new, you see its fixed price before it starts.

BCommercial policies

Payment, tax and running costs, in plain words.

The same terms go into every proposal.

01 / PAYMENT

Paid in milestones, never by the hour.

  • Smaller packages: 50% to start, 50% on go-live.
  • Larger projects: 40% to start, 40% when you sign off the test version, 20% on go-live.
  • Enterprise: fixed price per phase, 50% to start and 50% on sign-off.
  • International: 50% to start and 50% before go-live, in US dollars.
02 / TAXATION

18% GST in India. 0% for clients abroad.

Indian clients pay 18% GST: 9% CGST and 9% SGST in Gujarat, 18% IGST in other states. International clients are invoiced in US dollars with 0% Indian GST, as services exported from India are zero-rated under a Letter of Undertaking.

03 / ZERO MARKUP

Platforms bill you directly.

Hosting, AI usage, WhatsApp and app store fees are connected to your own billing at the provider's price. Our fee never changes because your usage grows. For voice agents you can pay the calling platform directly, or we bill minutes at a fixed rate written into your proposal.

CQuestions

Questions about packages and payment.

Ask us directly
Why fixed scope instead of hourly billing?

Hourly billing rewards the builder for taking longer. A fixed scope puts the risk of estimating on us: if something takes longer than we planned, that is our cost, not yours.

What if I need something outside the scope?

We quote it as a fixed-price change request. It starts only after your written approval, and the original price and date do not move.

What if my side is late with content or access?

If content, access or feedback is more than 5 working days late, the delivery date moves by the same number of days. The price does not change.

Is there a rush option?

Yes. Rush delivery cuts the timeline by up to 40%, at a fixed price agreed before kickoff.

Tell us what you need. Fixed scope. Fixed timeline.

A 20-minute call, then a written proposal with a fixed price and delivery date within 48 hours.
